title: Crush Zone
seo_title: Crush Zone Monster Truck Show in Lebanon, MO
description: Crush Zone is a monster truck show where you can watch trucks in live action, with two shows planned on January 8-9, 2027. This listing is for the Saturday, January 9 show at 1:00 PM. It takes place at the Kenneth E. Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, Missouri.
